detailed_description: The Color Palette Generator is a web-based algorithmic design tool that computes harmonious color schemes using advanced color theory principles. It employs HSL (Hue, Saturation, Lightness) color space calculations to generate mathematically accurate palettes including complementary (180° hue opposition), analogous (adjacent hues within 30°-60°), and triadic (evenly spaced 120° hues) combinations. The tool leverages the CIE Lab* perceptual color model to ensure optimal contrast ratios and accessibility compliance, automatically adjusting chromatic values through sigmoidal lightness curves to maintain visual consistency across shades. Designers and developers use this tool for creating cohesive UI/UX themes, branding materials, and accessible web content, as it programmatically derives color variations while preserving aesthetic harmony. The core algorithm utilizes vector math to traverse the cylindrical HSV color space, generating tints, shades, and tones with adjustable gamma correction for screen-accurate representation.
usage_steps: Open the interactive color wheel and select a base hue using the pointer or input HEX/RGB values manually
Choose a harmony mode from the dropdown: Complementary, Analogous, Triadic, or Monochromatic
Adjust the saturation spread slider (±30%) and lightness range (10%-90%) to define palette boundaries
Enable 'Accessibility Check' to validate WCAG 2.1 contrast ratios between color pairs
Click 'Generate' to create the optimized palette with 5-12 variant swatches per scheme
Export results as SCSS maps, CSS variables, or download as ACO Photoshop palette file
usage_examples: A web developer creating a dark mode interface needs triadic color sets with 4.5:1 minimum contrast against #1A1A1A background
Brand designer developing a seasonal product line requires analogous hues within 45° of Pantone 18-4052 Classic Blue
Game UI artist optimizing health/mana bars needs complementary red/cyan variants with equal perceived brightness
Data visualization engineer generating 12-category diverging color scales for heatmaps with CVD-friendly differentiation
